backup.title: Backups
backup.hint.schedule: The database and the stored calculation files are backed up every night at 3 am (one archive), and automatically before a database change during an update. Kept: the last 14 days, plus the last backup of each month (12 months). Backups before an update: the last 5.
backup.hint.confidential: Confidential: backups contain all data, including password hashes and encrypted two-factor secrets. Store them only in safe places and do not pass them on.

device.title: Devices
device.intro: Printers and dryers with their hourly rates. A printer's rate comes from purchase price, useful life and print hours per year; the dryers are spread over all print hours as one shared surcharge. Electricity is not included. A printer can be taken over from Bambuddy. A device can be deleted as long as no production hangs on it; otherwise it can only be deactivated.

device.surcharge.hint: Yearly costs of all active dryers divided by the print hours per year of all active printers. It is added to the hourly rate of every printer.

sales.error.inactive: A deactivated article cannot be sold.
sales.error.zero: The quantity must be at least 1.
sales.error.price: Please enter a price, e.g. 12.50 (at most 2 decimals, not negative).
sales.error.note_long: The note may have at most 200 characters.
sales.error.date: Please enter a valid date, not in the future.
sales.error.insufficient: Not enough stock: fewer pieces are available.
sales.cancel.title: Cancel sale
sales.cancel.confirm: The sale stays in the list as “cancelled”. The sold pieces go back into stock.
analysis_total.title: Analysis
analysis_total.error.period: Please choose a valid period: start and end as dates, the end not before the start and not too far in the future.
production.error.waste_share: The scrap share must be between 0 and 100 %.
analysis_total.failed_note: Whole failed prints plus scrap amounts, without labour; share of the total production cost of the period (with labour).
analysis_total.slow: Slow sellers (in stock, not sold for 90 days)
analysis_total.empty.top: Nothing sold in the period yet.
analysis_total.empty.flop: No further articles with sales in the period.
analysis_total.col.name: Name
analysis_total.note: Calculated from the sales and productions that are not cancelled. The cost of the sold pieces is valued per sale with the average of all pieces produced up to then. Stock value and slow sellers are of today, not of the period.
dashboard.todo.title: To do
dashboard.chart.title: Revenue and cost per month
dashboard.chart.summary: Bar chart: revenue and cost of the sold pieces per month, last 12 months
dashboard.chart.note: The last 12 months, whatever period is chosen.
filaments.title: Filaments
filaments.intro: A filament is a kind, e.g. “Bambu Lab · PLA Matte · Ivory White”. Later you assign the Bambuddy spools to it; Bambuddy stays unchanged.
filament.col.name: Filament
filaments.stock.unreadable: The stock cannot be read right now (Bambuddy does not answer). The prices are the stored values.
filament.hint.standard_price: Optional: your usual purchase price per kg, e.g. 19.90.
filament.hint.min_stock_kg: Optional: warning when all spools of this filament together hold less.
filament.error.chars: The text contains characters that are not allowed.
filament.error.color: Please enter a colour code like #FFFFF0.
filament.delete.title: Delete filament
filament.delete.confirm: The filament is deleted for good. Spools in Bambuddy stay unchanged.
filaments.spools.title: Assign spools
filaments.spools.intro: These Bambuddy spools do not belong to a filament yet. Each has a proposal; you confirm it one by one or all at once. Bambuddy stays unchanged.
filaments.spools.empty: All spools are assigned to a filament.
filaments.spools.not_set_up: Bambuddy is not set up yet, so there are no spools to assign.
filament.delete.blocked: Spools are assigned to this filament. It can only be switched off.
filaments.assigned.title: Spools of {name}
filaments.assigned.intro: These Bambuddy spools belong to the filament. Price and grams are the values from the moment of the assignment; they only change when you take over a price change. Bambuddy stays unchanged.
filaments.assigned.empty: No spools are assigned to this filament.
filaments.spools.unreadable: Bambuddy cannot be reached right now. The state of the spools cannot be read; stored values stay.
filaments.price.title: Take over price
filaments.price.question: The price of this spool changed in Bambuddy. Replace the stored value? The average and the last price of the filament then use the new price.
filaments.price.same: The price matches Bambuddy or cannot be read there. There is nothing to take over.
filaments.move.title: Assign spool to another filament
filaments.move.none: There is no other filament. Create one first.
filaments.move.error: Please choose a filament from the list.
filaments.release.title: Release assignment
filaments.release.question: The spool then belongs to no filament and shows again under "Assign spools". Nothing changes in Bambuddy.
filaments.price.notice: {n} spools have a different price in Bambuddy.
filaments.changes.title: Changed spool prices
filaments.changes.intro: The price of these spools in Bambuddy differs from the stored value. If you take it over, the average and the last price use the new price. Bambuddy stays unchanged.
filaments.changes.empty: All stored spool prices match Bambuddy.
calc.list.unit: Amounts in euro per piece, including the share of scrap.
